facts: Parties: Foxley Technologies Ltd (Buyer), Upton Pharma plc (Seller); the Company is Orwell Marine Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 29 December 2026; Closing is scheduled for 11 March 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 12 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 72 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 3 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $5,000,000, capped at $5,000,000.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Larkspur Energy plc. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $7,100,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $5,600,000.
